 Judgment

The petitioner in O.P.(M.V.) No.227 of 2014 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Palakkad, is the appellant herein.

(For the purpose of convenience, the parties are hereafter referred to as per their rank before the Tribunal).
2.
The petitioner filed the above O.P. under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, claiming compensation for the injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident that occurred on 10.08.2012.

According to the petitioner, on 10.08.2012 while he was riding pillion on a motorcycle bearing Registration No.TN-39-AE-9925, a lorry bearing Registration No.KL-10-AC-5989 driven by the 2nd respondent in a rash and negligent manner hit on the motorcycle and as such, he fell down and sustained serious injuries.
However, in the claim petition, in different columns the number of the offending vehicle was mistakenly shown as TN-39-AE-9925, instead of KL-10-AC-5989.
It was in the above context, the Tribunal dismissed the claim petition.

3. Heard Sri.Jacob Sebastian, the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner/appellant, and Sri.V.Jayapradeep, the learned Standing Counsel for the 3rd respondent.
4.

On a perusal of the award and documents produced, it appears that, MACA NO. 253 OF 2018 2025:KER:31464 in the claim petition, in different columns the number of the offending vehicle was mistakenly shown as TN-39-AE-9925, instead of KL-10-AC-5989.

It is only a clerical mistake and as such an opportunity is to be given to the petitioner to rectify the above mistake.
5.
Therefore, this appeal is allowed and the impugned award passed by the Tribunal is set aside.
The matter is remanded back to the Tribunal for fresh disposal, after affording opportunity to both sides to adduce evidence and to make amendments, if any, in the claim petition.
6. The parties are directed to appear before the Tribunal on 20.05.2025.
Tribunal shall take all efforts to dispose of this Original Petition at the earliest, at any rate, within a period of six months from 20.05.2025.
Registry is directed to re-transmit the entire TCR to the Tribunal, forthwith.

Sd/-
